scope: Refutes a universal bound for an indefinite rank-three quadratic pushforward based only on the Linfinity norm of an arbitrary three-dimensional input density. Does not refute the full original-coordinate product-law QFORM conjecture.
counterexample: For q=y1^2+y2^2-y3^2, use light-cone coordinates u=r-z, v=r+z and the unit-density probability set R<=v<=2R, 0<=u<=a_R, all angles, with a_R chosen for volume one. Then ||rho||inf=1 while p_q(s)=(pi/2)(R+s/(2R)) for 0<s<a_R R, hence ||p_q||inf>=pi R/2.
implication: Any rank-three coarea route must retain product-linear/fiber provenance beyond a bare projected or conditional Linfinity density cap.
